large_file_detection.rationale: No file-size/line-count hook, CI limit, LFS rule, or configured size/complexity platform check was found.

tech_debt_tracking.rationale: Ruff checks TODO formatting but explicitly ignores TD001-TD003, including issue links. No debt inventory, TODO scanner, or documented debt-tracking process was found.

build_cmd_doc.rationale: README.md COMPILE documents make, make yt-dlp, dependency installation, and python -m bundle.pyinstaller.

deps_pinned.rationale: Committed uv.lock pins resolved dependencies. bundle/requirements/*.txt also pins versions and hashes, and CI installs with --require-hashes.

vcs_cli_tools.rationale: Neither gh nor glab is installed; authenticated repository APIs and PR/CI history could not be checked.

automated_pr_review.rationale: Skipped: gh/glab is unavailable. Policy-enforcement comments in label-handler.yml are not generated code reviews.

agentic_development.rationale: No active agent configuration, agent workflow, or agent coauthorship was found in the available shallow history. .NO_AI/README.md and CONTRIBUTING.md explicitly prohibit AI contributions.

fast_ci_feedback.rationale: Skipped: no authenticated gh/glab access to PR check start/completion timestamps. Workflow timeouts do not establish actual CI duration.

build_performance_tracking.rationale: Skipped: no gh/glab timing access or deliberate build-performance measurement was found. Parallel build jobs and the nightly commit-hash cache alone do not establish performance tracking.

deployment_frequency.rationale: Skipped: release workflows exist, but gh/glab is unavailable to verify actual successful release/deployment frequency.

single_command_setup.rationale: CONTRIBUTING.md documents installing Hatch, hatch run setup, and hatch shell; it also documents running the source directly with python -m yt_dlp on supported Python.

feature_flag_infrastructure.rationale: No rollout-oriented feature flag system was found. CLI/extractor configuration options are not evidence of deployment feature flags.

release_notes_automation.rationale: release.yml generates notes with devscripts/make_changelog.py and updates Changelog.md through devscripts/update_changelog.py.

progressive_rollout.rationale: Skipped: this is a CLI/library repository, not infrastructure. Release channels are documented but are not scored as infrastructure canary rollouts.

rollback_automation.rationale: Skipped: this is not an infrastructure repository. README documents client version downgrades, rather than infrastructure rollback automation.

monorepo_tooling.rationale: Skipped: one root application/package. bundle and devscripts support the same application's build and release lifecycle.

version_drift_detection.rationale: Skipped: one build package/module. Dependency groups and platform requirement files are inputs to the same root project, not sibling build modules.

release_automation.rationale: release.yml builds and publishes GitHub/PyPI releases; release-master.yml triggers on relevant master pushes and release-nightly.yml is scheduled.

dead_feature_flag_detection.rationale: Skipped: feature_flag_infrastructure does not pass; there is no feature flag system requiring stale-flag detection.

agents_md.rationale: No root AGENTS.md exists. The repository instead explicitly prohibits AI contributions in .NO_AI/README.md and CONTRIBUTING.md.

readme.rationale: Root README.md provides installation, supported Python versions, dependencies, usage, configuration, build instructions, and examples.

automated_doc_generation.rationale: Makefile doc regenerates README CLI help, supported sites and issue templates. Release preparation runs make doc; manpages and completions are generated too.

skills.rationale: No repository-local .factory/skills, .skills, or .claude/skills SKILL.md files were found. Session-provided skills are not repository configuration.

documentation_freshness.rationale: The prescribed local git history check lists README.md and CONTRIBUTING.md under commit b77c930 dated 2026-10-29, within 180 days. This checkout is shallow, limiting historical precision.

service_flow_documented.rationale: README.md documents external service dependencies, including SponsorBlock's API and endpoint, YouTube Innertube hosts, and extractor-specific API configuration.

agents_md_validation.rationale: No AGENTS.md exists, and no automation validating or generating its setup/test commands was found. The prerequisite is not satisfied.

devcontainer.rationale: No .devcontainer/devcontainer.json exists. bundle/docker contains release-build containers, not a configured development container.

env_template.rationale: README.md documents environment variables and defaults, including XDG_CONFIG_HOME, XDG_CACHE_HOME, HOME and YTDLP_NO_PLUGINS; no mandatory secret env file is needed for basic CLI use.

local_services_setup.rationale: Skipped: the CLI has no required locally hosted database, cache, or service stack. External websites are remote download sources, and tests can supply local HTTP fixtures.

devcontainer_runnable.rationale: Skipped: the devcontainer CLI is not installed. No devcontainer configuration exists either.

runbooks_documented.rationale: No dedicated runbooks/playbooks or incident-response runbook pointers were found. General troubleshooting and contribution instructions do not establish an operations runbook.

branch_protection.rationale: Skipped: gh/glab is unavailable, so administrator access and active rulesets/legacy branch protection could not be verified.

secret_scanning.rationale: Skipped: no repository secret-scanner hook/workflow was found, and unavailable gh/glab prevents checking admin access and native secret-scanning status.

codeowners.rationale: No CODEOWNERS file was found at root, in .github, or elsewhere in the repository.

automated_security_review.rationale: .github/workflows/codeql.yml runs CodeQL analysis for Python, JavaScript/TypeScript and Actions on pushes, PRs and a schedule, publishing readable code-scanning findings.

dependency_update_automation.rationale: Custom dlp-bot automation is evidenced by generated EJS dependency metadata in Makefile and recent dependency/action update PRs recorded in Changelog.md, including #17924, #17933 and #17925.

gitignore_comprehensive.rationale: .gitignore covers Python/build artifacts, cookies, .netrc, IDE and OS files, but does not exclude .env or .env.* secret files.

privacy_compliance.rationale: Skipped: this local CLI/library does not operate a centralized end-user data collection or tracking service. Personal metadata handling is evaluated separately under pii_handling.

secrets_management.rationale: Release workflows reference GitHub Actions secrets for signing and publishing without embedding values. README also documents restricted .netrc permissions and external credential commands.

min_release_age.rationale: pyproject.toml sets tool.uv.exclude-newer to 7 days, mirrored by uv.lock's P7D policy. Several explicit package exemptions exist, so the delay is not universal.

issue_templates.rationale: .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE contains structured broken-site, site-request, site-feature, general bug, feature and question templates.

issue_labeling_system.rationale: Issue templates and label-handler.yml show type/site/triage labels, but no complete priority/type/area taxonomy was established; priority labels could not be verified locally.

backlog_health.rationale: Skipped: gh/glab is unavailable, so the required sample of open issue titles, labels, age and recent activity could not be checked.

pr_templates.rationale: .github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md includes description, issue context and contribution/type checklists, but no section recording testing actually performed.

lint_config.rationale: pyproject.toml configures Ruff with Pyflakes, pycodestyle, import, naming and other rules. Quick Test CI runs ruff check.

type_check.rationale: No mypy, Pyright or equivalent Python static type-checker configuration or CI task was found. Type hints and Ruff linting alone do not satisfy this criterion.

formatter.rationale: pyproject.toml configures autopep8 and Hatch formatting commands; CI runs autopep8 --diff and pre-commit applies formatting.

pre_commit_hooks.rationale: .pre-commit-config.yaml runs Ruff fixes and autopep8. A Hatch hook configuration is also checked in, with installation documented in CONTRIBUTING.md.

strict_typing.rationale: No strict Python static type-checker mode is configured; neither mypy strict nor an equivalent Pyright configuration was found.

naming_consistency.rationale: Ruff enforces N803/N804 argument naming rules, and CONTRIBUTING.md explicitly requires extractor class names ending in IE.

cyclomatic_complexity.rationale: No configured cyclomatic/cognitive complexity analyzer or threshold was found. Ruff does not enable C901 or Pylint complexity/refactor rules.

dead_code_detection.rationale: Ruff's selected Pyflakes F rules detect unused imports and local variables in CI, with a narrow generated-template exception.

duplicate_code_detection.rationale: No duplication detector, CPD/jscpd configuration, or duplication-reporting CI task was found.

code_modularization.rationale: The large Python application has distinct extractor/networking/downloader/postprocessor packages, but no import-linter or architectural layer/boundary enforcement was found.

n_plus_one_detection.rationale: Skipped: no application-owned database or ORM is used. Reading browser cookie databases does not create an application query layer requiring N+1 detection.

heavy_dependency_detection.rationale: Skipped: this is a Python CLI/library, not a browser-bundled application. PyInstaller release packaging does not establish a frontend bundle-size budget requirement.

unused_dependencies_detection.rationale: No deptry, pip-extra-reqs or equivalent unused-dependency check was found. Ruff's unused-import checks do not analyze declared package dependencies.

unit_tests_exist.rationale: test/ contains many unit tests, including test_cache.py, test_aes.py, test_traversal.py and test_utils.py; test_cache.py was selected for bounded collection.

integration_tests_exist.rationale: test_downloader_http.py exercises the real downloader against an in-process HTTP server. Network/proxy, subprocess CLI and extractor download integration tests also exist.

unit_tests_runnable.rationale: Skipped: the required Python >=3.11 runtime is unavailable. Direct bounded collection, python -m pytest --collect-only -p no:cacheprovider test/test_cache.py, exited 4 at the explicit unsupported-Python import guard under Python 3.9.13. No tests ran.

test_performance_tracking.rationale: No pytest --durations setting, retained timing/JUnit reports, or test analytics integration was found. Default pytest elapsed summaries do not establish tracked test performance.

flaky_test_detection.rationale: Core and Quick Test workflows configure --reruns 2 --reruns-delay 3.0. test/conftest.py and devscripts/run_tests.py also support explicit flaky-test exclusion.

test_coverage_thresholds.rationale: No enforced minimum coverage percentage exists. Hatch's run-cov command explicitly says Code coverage not implemented and exits 1.

test_naming_conventions.rationale: Existing files follow test_*.py, but pytest configuration does not explicitly set discovery naming patterns and no documented test-file naming rule was found.

test_isolation.rationale: The Hatch test environment configures pytest-randomly and pytest-xdist; pytest-randomly provides test randomization. Network tests also use per-test local server fixtures.

interactive_qa_exists.rationale: CONTRIBUTING.md documents direct python -m yt_dlp execution; README specifies Python >=3.11, optional dependencies, and CLI interactions such as --list-impersonate-targets/--list-extractors. These offline paths need no login or local services.

interactive_qa_runnable.rationale: Documentation fallback used: the bounded offline CLI attempt exited 1 at the Python >=3.11 guard under Python 3.10.7. The documented supported-Python source launch and list command form a complete no-auth, no-service QA path; actual execution was not confirmed.

api_schema_docs.rationale: Skipped: yt-dlp consumes external APIs but does not serve an HTTP/GraphQL API. Recursive OpenAPI/Swagger/GraphQL schema searches found none.

database_schema.rationale: Skipped: the CLI has no application-owned database schema or migrations. Browser cookie database readers operate on external application data.

structured_logging.rationale: A custom _YDLLogger adapter exists inside general-purpose utils/_utils.py, but no dedicated logger module or configured logging-library dependency was found; CLI output is primarily plain text.

distributed_tracing.rationale: No application-wide trace/request ID propagation, OpenTelemetry integration, or equivalent distributed tracing configuration was found.

metrics_collection.rationale: No configured application metrics exporter or telemetry backend was found. Download progress callbacks alone are not a metrics collection system.

code_quality_metrics.rationale: Skipped: no coverage/complexity/maintainability metrics tracking was found, and gh/glab is unavailable to verify native code-scanning analyses or coverage bot reports. CodeQL configuration alone does not verify these metrics.

error_tracking_contextualized.rationale: No Sentry, Bugsnag, Rollbar or equivalent contextualized production error-tracking integration was found.

alerting_configured.rationale: No PagerDuty/OpsGenie integration or custom operational alerting rules were found. CLI warnings and CI failure statuses are not configured operational alerting.

deployment_observability.rationale: No deploy-impact monitoring dashboard pointers, deployment annotations, or deploy notification integrations were found.

health_checks.rationale: Skipped: the application is a CLI/library rather than a continuously deployed service requiring health endpoints or readiness/liveness probes.

circuit_breakers.rationale: External-call resilience is implemented with RetryManager and retry sleep functions. README documents linear and exponential --retry-sleep configuration, including fragment:exp=1:20.

profiling_instrumentation.rationale: Performance profiling is meaningful for this downloader, but no configured profiler, flamegraph workflow, continuous profiling or APM instrumentation was found.

dast_scanning.rationale: Skipped: the application is not deployed as a web service. Local HTTP fixtures test the client, not a web service staging target for DAST.

pii_handling.rationale: README warns that info-json may contain personal information and documents default internal-metadata cleanup. It also documents protected credential files; Config.hide_login_info masks usernames/passwords in debug configuration output.

log_scrubbing.rationale: Config.hide_login_info in yt_dlp/utils/_utils.py replaces username/password arguments with PRIVATE, including --option=value forms, before configuration is logged.

product_analytics_instrumentation.rationale: No Mixpanel, Amplitude, PostHog, Heap, GA4 or equivalent product-usage analytics instrumentation was found.

error_to_insight_pipeline.rationale: No configured error-tracker-to-issue integration or automatic issue creation from operational errors was found. User issue templates and policy comments do not satisfy this criterion.
